body.message:
Hi! I’m looking to rent this 3-bedroom apartment for one month from 15th July to 14th August

Could you please let me know:

* Which floor is the apartment on?
* Could you share the actual photos and a video of the apartment (not just the listing photos)?
* Is the quoted price all-inclusive (utilities, Wi-Fi, etc.), or are there any additional charges?

Thank you!
